```{r, echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message=FALSE}
#load library
library(b3gbi)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(sf)
```

The indicators displayed below were calculated for flowering plants recorded in Flanders from 1975 onwards. Details of the download settings are available from GBIF.org (16 June 2026) GBIF Occurrence Download https://doi.org/10.15468/dl.9rpv52.

::: {.callout-tip collapse="true" appearance="minimal" icon="false"}
{{< include TotalOccurrences.Rmd >}}

# **Total Occurrences**

```{r, eval=FALSE, warning = FALSE, message=FALSE}
#load library
library(b3gbi)

TO_map <- total_occ_map(Angiosperm_data_cube,
                            cell_size="grid")

TO_ts <- total_occ_ts(Angiosperm_data_cube, 
                          cell_size="grid")

plot_map(TO_map, 
         visible_gridlines = FALSE)

plot_ts(TO_ts)
```

```{r, echo=FALSE, warning = FALSE, message=FALSE}
TO_map <- readRDS('./Flanders_Florabank_10km/TO_map.rds')$data

ggplot(data = TO_map) +
  geom_sf(aes(fill = diversity_val), color = NA) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(na.value = NA) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "Observed species richness based on raw GBIF data") +
  theme(legend.title = element_blank())
```

```{r, echo=FALSE, warning = FALSE, message=FALSE}
TO_ts <- readRDS('./Flanders_Florabank_10km/TO_ts.rds')

TO_ts_data <- TO_ts$data

ggplot(TO_ts_data, aes(year, diversity_val)) +
  geom_point(
    size = 3,
    colour = "#48A529"
  ) +
  geom_smooth(
    method = "loess",
    se = FALSE,
    colour = "#005957",
    fill = "#6CDDB4",
    linewidth = 1.3
  ) +
  expand_limits(y = 0) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    limits = c(min(TO_ts_data$year, na.rm = TRUE), 2022)
  ) +
labs(
    title = "Total number of occurrences in Flanders based on raw GBIF data",
    y = "Number of occurrences",
    x = "Year"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()



```
:::

::: {.callout-tip collapse="true" appearance="minimal" icon="false"}
## Observed Species Richness

{{< include ObservedSpeciesRichness.Rmd >}}

```{r, eval=FALSE, warning = FALSE, message=FALSE}
#load library
library(b3gbi)


#Execute preprocessing step (TEST)
OSR_map <- obs_richness_map(Angiosperm_data_cube,
                            cell_size="grid")

OSR_ts <- obs_richness_ts(Angiosperm_data_cube, 
                          cell_size="grid")

plot_map(OSR_map,
         visible_gridlines = FALSE)

plot_ts(OSR_ts)
```

```{r, echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message=FALSE}
OSR_map <- readRDS("./Flanders_Florabank_10km/OSR_map.rds")$data

ggplot(data = OSR_map) +
  geom_sf(aes(fill = diversity_val), color = NA) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(na.value = NA, name='number of species') +
  labs(title = "Observed species richness based on raw GBIF data") +
  theme_void()

```

The map below displays observed species richness in Flanders, but only where completeness is larger than 0.5. The regions which are not displayed, are undersampled.

```{r, echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message=FALSE}
completeness_map <- readRDS("./Flanders_Florabank_10km/ComP_map.rds")$data


threshold <- 0.5

# Assuming both datasets have the same geometry/order
OSR_masked <- OSR_map %>%
  left_join(
    completeness_map %>%
      st_drop_geometry() %>%
      select(cellCode, completeness=diversity_val),
    by = "cellCode"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    diversity_val = ifelse(completeness >= threshold,
                           diversity_val,
                           NA)
  )

ggplot(data = OSR_masked) +
  geom_sf(aes(fill = diversity_val), color = NA) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(na.value = NA,
                       name= 'Number of species') +
  theme_void()+
  labs(title = "Observed species richness at locations with high estimated completeness")+
  theme(legend.title = element_text("Number of occurrences"))


```

```{r, echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message=FALSE}
OSR_ts <- readRDS('./Flanders_Florabank_10km/OSR_ts.rds')

data <- OSR_ts$data

ggplot(data, aes(year, diversity_val)) +
  geom_point(
    size = 3,
    colour = "#48A529"
  ) +
  geom_smooth(
    method = "loess",
    se = FALSE,
    colour = "#005957",
    fill = "#6CDDB4",
    linewidth = 1.3
  ) +
  expand_limits(y = 0) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    limits = c(min(data$year, na.rm = TRUE), 2022)
  ) +
labs(
    title = "Total observed species richness in Flanders based on raw GBIF data",
    y = "Number of species",
    x = "Year"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

```
:::
